[quote=orphogron;59354671]What are the rules for when I can make an expansion post?[/quote]

From the guide:

> You can expand once a month up to a maximum of 40,000 pixels. To expand, you have to write RP posts. 1 word in RP is worth 5 pixels on the map. Your RP posts can be worldbuilding in dispatches, storytelling on our RMB, or anything that is directly related to the development of your new land.

So think about how much you want to expand, write RP posts, and then tell the Cartographers you've RPed enough and to expand your claim.
